title: Main carries the contract folders and slot-contract maxVersion of JA Restaurant EmDash 1.0.4 and JA Diner EmDash 0.1.4, so the production road can measure the published versions
steps: S1: In the checkout after pnpm install, run run.cmd (no database, no network).
S2: Confirm the test reports ok.
expect: For every EmDash tag in template-profiles.json, the newest version with a row has packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-<name>/contracts/<version>/.
A slot contract under packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates names a maxVersion for that tag at or above that version.
fence: an EmDash version with a profile row on a branch also has its contract folder and slot-contract range there
